title: LawPayload
description: Governance law or rule definition imported from rules files (spec 09).

law_id.description: Unique law identifier (e.g. LAW-007 or synthesised stem from filename).

title.description: Short title extracted from the rule heading.

severity.description: Declared severity; null when not specified.

section_index.description: Zero-based section index when the source file was split per ## heading.

source_path.description: Relative path of the source file within the repo.
